incident-bot: :rotating_light: alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected across inference-proxy for /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank; chat p95 latency increasing. Auto-paged on-call.
Jia (oncall): I'm on it, looking at dashboards now. embeddings 5xx ~12% (5m), rerank 8%, chat p95 ~900ms.
Mike: any recent deploys? I see a quantized-embeddings model rollout around 02:14 UTC.
Jia (oncall): not in the deployment history for the proxies. Traces show a small set of tenants sending huge parallel embedding jobs — ACME vector-sync looks suspicious.
Sam: can we throttle by route quickly? prioritize chat and protect core routing.
Jia (oncall): agreed. mitigation plan (short):
  1) temporarily reduce public embeddings QPS to 5 (burst 10)
  2) reduce rerank route to 10 QPS
  3) cap chat unstable-suffix to 25 QPS to keep interactive flows alive
  4) enable 429 on exceed and notify customers + CS 
  5) if pressure persists, disable rerank.experimental for free-tier
Mike: runbook commands to apply (RFC):
```
# set per-route qps
rwctl route update --route "/v1/embeddings" --qps 5 --burst 10 --reason "incident mitigation"
rwctl route update --route "/v1/rerank" --qps 10 --burst 20 --reason "incident mitigation"
rwctl route update --route "/v1/chat" --route-suffix "/unstable" --qps 25 --reason "incident mitigation"
# optional: feature flag disable
featurectl disable rerank.experimental --scope free --reason "mitigation"
```
Jia (oncall): executing now. kicking off ops job.
ops-runbooks-bot: Job 45678 started: applying route QPS updates (eta ~15s).
ops-runbooks-bot: Job 45678: completed update /v1/embeddings qps -> 5
ops-runbooks-bot: Job 45678: completed update /v1/rerank qps -> 10
ops-runbooks-bot: Job 45678: completed update /v1/chat (unstable) qps -> 25
Jia (oncall): immediate signal: embeddings 5xx dropping to ~3% in the first 30s. Good.
Carla: I'll contact ACME support and request they pause vector-sync jobs and switch to batched embeddings. Preparing an email template.
Sam: any customer list for impacts? I can prep CS templates.
Jia (oncall): Affected customers seen in traces: ACME (heavy embeddings), BetaStore (rerank spikes), ~30 dev workspaces hit chat cap (mostly 429s, not errors). Impact summary: embeddings = High (batch synces), rerank = Medium (some degraded ranking results), chat = Low (rate-limited interactive flows).
Carla: CS action: open incident tickets for ACME + BetaStore, send immediate mitigation checklist and ask for backoff.
Mike: i pushed the featurectl disable for rerank.experimental on free-tier as a precaution. Response should reduce background rerank pressure.
Jia (oncall): switching to monitoring mode. leaving trace and dashboard links: https://console.redwood.inference/ops/incidents/1737004321 and https://tracing.redwood/trace/span12345
Sam: any need to route traffic to dedicated pool or change model variant?
Jia (oncall): not yet. we're seeing good recovery after route caps. If embeddings trend back up, we will route ACME to a heavier-capacity dedicated pool or lower its parallelism via per-tenant policy.
Carla: handoff: @Carla taking over follow-up and customer comms. Jia — please leave any logs/commands you ran.
Jia (oncall): done. commands and job ids in ops job 45678. Last read: embeddings 5xx 0.8%, rerank 5xx 1.2%, chat p95 320ms.
Carla: noted. I'll schedule a 1pm war room if secondary regressions appear and assemble a short post-incident timeline. Action items:
  - keep per-route caps for 2 hours and re-evaluate
  - CS to confirm ACME backoff and BetaStore mitigations
  - infra to consider lowering shared-tenant embedding burst allowance in next config change
Sam: add a follow-up to Product: consider per-tenant quota dashboard to spot future sync storms.
Carla: will do. closing active mitigation. please drop any residual observations here. :thumbsup:
Jia (oncall): final note at 1737007890 — metrics stable, moving to recovery/monitoring.
